verdict.rationale: LangSmith explicitly documents automating workflows with 'rules, webhooks, and online evaluations,' plus threshold-based alerts (on run count, cost, errors, feedback score, latency) that trigger routed actions to Slack, PagerDuty, Dynatrace, or custom webhooks — a clear rules-trigger-action automation model. Missing for 10: detailed docs/UI walkthrough of rule-definition syntax/conditions and independent/hands-on confirmation that custom rule automations work as advertised beyond the alerting subset.
